key_structures: Main sanctum with svayambhu murti of Goddess Bhavani
Kallola Tirtha and Gomukha Tirtha (sacred stepping water springs)
Sardar Nimbalkar entrance gateway and Chhatrapati Shivaji Mahadwar
special_features: Chala murti (movable deity) taken out in sacred palanquin three times a year during sleep/shayana periods
Natural springs feeding ancient sacred tirthas within the temple complex
Historic sacred tree where Chhatrapati Shivaji received the blessed Bhavani Talwar
materials: Carved stone pillars with floral reliefs
renovation_history: Ancient forest shrine patronized by Yadavas; rebuilt and fortified by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and subsequent Maratha rulers in 17th century.
